游戏总的来说还可以，但有些问题急需调整 一个是护盾被打不算无伤，这游戏不管你挨打了有没有掉血，只要受到攻击那就不算无伤，哪怕是在有护盾的情况下只要你被攻击了那无伤就没了。这很不合理啊，被打的是盾又不是肉凭什么不算无伤呢，这一定得改一下 第二个是有些角色急需增强，在不用通用轮椅的情况下，你去玩一些贴近这个角色机制的流派你就会发现有的角色弱离谱。比如初始角色丹朱，贴近她机制的流派那肯定是重击流，通过三次武器升级达成光速轻重击，成型之后就是一秒两个轻击加两个满蓄重击。我用这流派打熊毫难度，400%的全能增伤，200%的轻重增伤，80%的免伤，五百多点血，结果要伤害没伤害要坦度没坦度，别说打BOSS了，打小怪都是刮痧。那这角色要怎么玩呢，只能去玩那些所有角色都能玩的技能流，特效流这种通用流派。那这角色存在的意义是什么呢，所以说这种角色赶紧加强，你至少让每个角色都有那么一两套能玩的比较爽的结合自身机制的专属流派吧。 第三点是可以给丹药还有奇物加个分解，让玩家把不需要的丹药跟奇物分解成钱 第四点可以在商店处开个卖墨宝的商店，还有奇物商店那可以加个锁定商品，这样玩家想要但是买不起的商品可以锁了下次来买 第五点是有个bug，商店处的假人只显示宠物伤害不显示玩家伤害，赶紧修一下

不推荐： 1.局外养成因素薄弱，才几个小时就把几乎所有的养成解锁完毕 2.敌人伤害判定迷，有些攻击明明离角色模型很远但还是有伤害 3.敌人抬手似神经，部分敌人的连段反直觉：刚出手重击马上又接一个突击，前者的动程尚未结束下一招就到脸上了。。。 4.近战流派孱弱，自保能力差，输出收益低 5.数值不合理，高难度你就刮吧，挨敌人随便一个平A就要掉一层皮。打起来很憋屈 6.主角大部分攻击只能站桩输出，敌人受击无反馈无硬直，跑的稍慢就要被换血 以上几点是我粗粗体验下来感受到的最大的问题，至于其他的诸如剧情几近为零；粗糙特效乱飞糊眼；敌人受击反馈弱；局内构筑薄弱等等问题尚不影响该游戏的框架。只是可惜了一个好游戏的底子 上述陈列问题望贵游重视

整体来讲不如暖雪 首先肉鸽游戏两个要素 1.闯关过程中的随机武器功法道具体验 2.闯关失败后拿材料强化角色 目角色的墨宝和遗物是通用的也就角色功法直接差距才是随机 然后功法产出量太低 只有开局和关卡boss大部分都拿不到玩的也不爽 应该设定关卡中间小boss必出 天劫谷墨神境有30%概率出功法才达到随机性 至于游戏的娱乐性有两种，第一个是游戏本身好玩 第二个是刷图赚狐血墨强化角色 目前点完天赋也就开局老头的密保可以消耗墨水 价格太离谱了我打半小时才500 老头开局就要我600还给的一些大概占我战力构成的15%不到要我全部收益 像隔壁暖雪开局踏风草从头爽到尾战力提升300%还是免费的 所以狐血墨的消耗我觉得可以弄一个神器系统3千墨水解锁 神器要买 比如攻击神器轩辕剑增加暴击爆伤 异常触发 伤害时间 防御神器东皇钟 增加减伤和血量上限护盾获得量 打怪概率吸血吸盾 被打全屏反伤 炼妖瓶:打怪吸收对应强度的能量 满了出丹药 差不多通过弄出 2传说 6史诗 15普通 _______ 昨天买了哈迪斯我觉得你们这游戏还是有可取之处的 哈迪斯太抠门打銭要走专门的金币房 垃圾神祇祝福一次才2点暴击 哪怕用锤子进化两次打精英怪房也要50秒 boss也要2分钟 玩起来没你们这个爽 ———————— 不过强化内容还是太少了要搞多点局外强化

很早以前暖雪刚刚通关dlc的时候就被推荐了墨境，不过也是玩累了要歇一阵子就没玩。后来听说了墨境上架下架的风波和曲折的经历，稍微有些关注。前两天听说正式版即将上架，迎来ea版最后的打折，于是也是下载体验了一阵，确实很好玩，遂光速购买支持。 我暂时还没玩过哈迪斯，结合目前龙毫溃散21的游戏体验和暖雪进行对比，进行简单的评价，以供玩家或者制作组参考。如果你觉得我说的不对，那就是我说的不对。 如果标记暖雪为十分的话（暖雪对我来说没有到满分的程度，仅仅作为对比），那么墨境如今则在七分左右。谈一谈扣分点。 首先是bug类（这些作为新游上线待优化的内容，不纳入扣分考量）： 1，第一个bug是，每次进入boss关卡后有概率卡住，动画效果正常播放，鼠标可以移动，但是esc菜单、攻击以及任何按键都没有反应，只能大退游戏重新加载重进boss关卡。但是书灵转阶段后遇到这个bug，大退会重新进入一阶段无限打一阶段书灵。这个bug在点击“检查游戏文件完整性”后神秘消失，再也没有复发过。这个bug触发和修复前后都没有热更新。初步猜测卡顿原因是boss动画没有被空格正确跳过、初见没有跳过导致的？ 2，第二个bug是一个计数器问题，和上一个或许有关联。即每次见到boss解锁新见面剧情并弹出成就，而非击败boss。导致我大退解决上一个bug、甚至小退到菜单的时候，快速解锁了相识相亲boss之类的成就。同时可能是因此或者因为别的原因，我通关龙毫以后即无新难度，也无新结局；第二次通关龙毫时，丹朱突然说“这张秘符要也能用用看吗”，我一句剧情没漏看却不知道秘符从哪里来的，百思不得其解；随后使用并通关墨神、返回客栈之后，老板娘才问“你手上的秘符好眼熟能否借我一观”，并从丹朱口中得知打败书灵以后掉落的；随后我又通关了一次溃散，一样是打穿书灵和墨神，至今还没“捡到”“掉落”的秘符。 然后是真正影响游戏评价的地方： 1，剧情文案扣分。同样是跨时间线、复活、反抗神的定型故事，暖雪是哑巴主角靠物品线索推理故事，玩家主动度更高；墨境则选择了主要通过对话和过场动画来演出。 这带来了两个优势，第一是npc对话文本量更大，npc性格更加立体形象（相比之下暖雪除了小师妹，偷儿铁匠和尚都偏工具人，即使烬梦dlc追加了塑造也是如此）；另一方面主角也更有个性，临摹画皮换能力的设定不仅贴合故事背景也让人际关联交织更深密。 但反过来，也带来了两个问题。首先是建议npc修改为“有新对话时进行提示”和“可以重复对话”，否则对话没仔细看就不能重看内容了，或者对话每次都看很拖时间、但是已经开始重复内容了又不想错过，这是自相矛盾的设计，对剧情党很折磨。另一方面，在主线过场之中主角和npc反反复复说了太多次“自由”“支配”“命运”“自己掌握”“我命由我不由天”“操控”“有什么意义”“关你何事”，这实在是令人感觉尴尬无语。贵游对游戏受众的定位是大学乃至社会人士，不是初中生，在这个人群里很多人纯为了战斗爽不打算看剧情，看剧情的也不是小白了，谁受得了整页整页的“我的命运由我做主”啊。 2，小怪生成机制扣分。暖雪采用的过图方式是“狭长地图”配合“前方快速刷怪”，这样玩家在冲刺爆杀的同时会有源源不断的怪物从前方杀来；而墨境采用的是“双、三地块小地图”“身边刷怪”和“波次清图刷怪”，这就导致经常出现“杀完等怪”、“身后刷怪”、“冲到门前无事可做只能往回走”的情况把把都出现，不论是对速通玩家还是对普通玩家都是一种折磨。对前者无法好好速刷，对后者身后刷怪有加大了注意力消耗，而且对两者都大大加深了对关卡单张地图的疲劳程度。 3，伤害范围提示扣分。这里就要举例另外一个例子，就是隔壁灰烬之国。我对灰烬之国的试玩体验评价目前是比墨境低的，其原因就在于：爽游不仅要玩家性能强，怪物性能也要强。灰烬之国就是怪物弹道技能飞行速度太慢了，导致根本不需要冲刺躲，甚至可能走路躲过了冲刺反而撞上去。墨境同样存在这个问题，伤害显示之后怪物出伤过于延后了。在普通关卡小怪技能太好躲过，在boss房或者无回镇红色伤害范围指示器都消失一两秒了墨炮或者飞箭才姗姗来迟，很多时候都是自己撞上去的。伤害指示器不是用来迷惑玩家配合怪物打快慢刀的，怎么能有的立刻出伤动画，有的比如扑击、弹道就延后出伤害呢？出伤应该快速、紧贴伤害指示器才对。 4，玩法深度。暖血八个塑像每个都有两个流派，每个流派武学配合至少有两个甚至三个操作明显不同的玩法。冲刺、挂buff引爆、躺地上、闪避、重击、间歇轻击、持续轻击、蓄力、攒豆子、平砍爆层数、技能dot等等。每一种的“操作逻辑”都是相差很大的，甚至还会根据道中的遗物（对标墨宝）产生不同的构筑逻辑。 墨境不同职业看似攻击模式不一样，但是其实同质化严重，基本上都是轻重击切换，只是属性加成不一样。除了盾伤、召唤、阵法、奇珍充能流、冲刺闪避稍微有所分支，其他几乎没有区别。然而即便是这些分支，其叠层和追加伤害还有核心墨宝效果也和轻击重击高度绑定。这就造成几乎可以暴论墨境近战都是砍王，远程都是加特林，大都不得不一直a。 最重要的是，虽然墨宝理论搭配上限很高，但是因为属性获取不够极端，而是平衡性做得很好（三选一丹药，收益相似），导致主要build在于选什么加成最大化dps而不是build思路方向，大多数时候双墨宝槽位（相比暖雪四遗物）开局就可以选定，后续仅仅是在升级墨宝而已。墨宝效果依赖轻击重击叠加和触发，相比暖雪将机制拆分放在功法和武器中，墨境选择将机制拆分放在传说墨宝、奇珍和丹药中。这就导致前期大部分时间都是在叠数值，中期解锁机制之后联动展现出数值，成长曲线非常线性，几乎可以预判在哪一章升级史诗墨、哪一章出传说墨、哪一章开始传说奇珍史诗集中拿到key，然而快结束才来的key就像是工作一个月才有的薪水，没什么惊喜感。暖雪将机制和大倍率拆分藏在功法、道具、遗物和词条这些随机性之中，让你真刷到成型就会感觉异常兴奋。而墨境虽然史诗里有大倍率，但前期则是通过蓝白奇珍和丹药里，你明明白白自己每个乘区有多少增伤，明明白白自己涉及到轻击重击、全能增伤、异常、诅咒、阵、墨宝技、追加那几个词条，你要做的只是在自己确定的几个词条里不断百分之几百分之几的加伤害，叠buff，叠数值，这是一种非常机械的计算。 The game and the art are extremely cool, however there's a couple of downsides, 1) PvP is really easy. Now I can see why its very easy, because you can't heal the most often, but it can kind of get boring, especially when you die and have to restart over again. 2) the run throughs only take about 17-20 minutes for your first time, or around 15 when you've done it a few times. 3) you can kind of just a very good pet at the start, or upgrade it through the stages, but after that it makes the game even easier. So on top of an already easier PvP, you can get items and pets that make it so much easier. However, it is pretty fun, and after getting used to the controls, this game doesn't take that much time to get good at. I would definitely recommend giving this game a chance, especially if you're looking for a new game. Overall, I can see this game getting a 7.75-8 ish, whether you're looking for something a little easier than hades, or just getting into the roguelike genre, it really just depends.

Absolutely yes, with qualifiers. This game is gameplay forward. The story is beautiful and the art is breathtaking, but the story is a little light. It reads like a fairytale, not a novel. People call this a Hades II clone, and even if it theoretically could have started that way, that's not really true. It's Dynasty Warriors. If you like Dynasty Warriors, and you like Hades I/II, you'll like this, because it's like if those two games boinked and had a really artistic baby. Having play both, the combat in this is far more satisfying. The bosses are fast-paced and punishing, but you can read them if you take time to learn them and don't panic. I love this game. It's imperfect, but it's also v1.07, and I am so excited to see what new build varieties come out in the coming year. It's a phenomenal game, top to bottom.

Realm of Ink is a game that plays a lot like Hades but lets you make more complex builds and is a bit faster. The developer (Leap) is Chinese and that comes through in story and game elements, it feels like it respects Chinese mythology and culture. Also the ink-brush painting aesthetic is something I really liked. However, there is some pretty overt fan service in the character models that I found a little off-putting. Overall I rate this game a guilty pleasure; it is fun to play. I am writing this review after getting all of the achievements, which took about 35 hours. For comparison, doing the same in Hades 1 and 2 took over 100 hours each for me. So right out of the box, let me tell you the game is fairly easy. Especially if you have played Hades or games like it before. I have done a few dozen runs, and I think I have only lost 3 of them total; largely due to me being greedy. Despite how this sounds, I actually think this is the developer's intent. The game starts on the lowest possible difficulty ranking and each clear allows you to go up to the next difficulty tier. There's about 7 of those tiers before you get into adding on additional difficulty modifiers. I think they let you work through the difficulty at an executable pace (it is a rougelite after all) so that you are ready for the next tier when you get there. And to be clear, the game is easy because they give you so much room to work. There's like 100 different Curio's that alter the game in various ways that allows you to make your build pretty overpowered if you are trying for synergy. There's also around 30ish different relics that give new buttons to push (you can only have up to 2 at a time) and a lot of absurdly powerful elixirs that you can pick up. So a lot of the difficulty removal comes from decisions that the player makes. That's part of what makes it fun. There's a also around a dozen different 'skins' that have their own move sets and ability upgrades that really change the game up. By endgame there are 6 total biomes to progress through, the first four of which can alternate between two different choices. This keeps the game from getting stale. In the extreme upper end of difficulty it can take quite a while for things to die. I did find that my computer (specs attached) chugged a good bit deep into the game when there were screens of enemies alive taking damage with 10's of millions of health. I didn't encounter any crashes, but there were slowdowns there and in the 'endless' mode. Overall its a 9/10 for me, I really enjoyed it. Its a good game to start up and just destroy things for an hour when you have the time.

I really wanted to like the game, but the entire experience was subpar or just plain average. TLDR; I cannot recommend the game even on discount. There are better, tighter gameplay alternatives & more engaging, insightful meta-commentary on the "character knows they are in a video game". I'll still play to pass time and holding hope for updates to improve it. Would love to change this review to positive because I think the ink art style & chinese mythology are fantastic. Issues: [list] [*] The translation & text is off; the chinese dialogue doesnt match the text & formatting is off whenever there's symbols like '. Terrible formatting in the skins section with text overlapping one another. [*] The voice acting is fine. Not bad, but not great. Rather than the simple script, I had bigger issues with the overall soundscape. [*] The music and sound effects are bland. The soundtrack never built the hype for the moment. The sound effects when hitting enemies or casting your ink spells had little impact. It was never satisfying. Some bosses felt like they were blatantly missing sound effects [*] Speaking of hit feedback, I had no idea what was happening in my status effect build. Numbers were going up, enemies were exploding (with no satisfaction again because of bland sound effects) and the screen was overwhelming with effects. I knew mechanically I was stacking effects and detonating them, and complementing curios adding damages, but I felt indifferent to it. [*] Combat was okay for a bit until I got a legendary curio in said status effect run and it completely trivialised the run. I won a boss fight standing at the edge of the map. Even in standard runs, it didn't click. The combat was not as tight and fluid as it should be. Never mind Hades, even other roguelites have tighter controls. The invincibility frames/dodging times felt off, and I took three continuous hits unable to get the timing down (could be a skill issue). [*] The story really disappointed. I heard about the premise and was excited for meta-commentary and 4th wall breaking narrator; like Icey or Stanley Parable. In the end, it was rather very basic. The story did nothing with the premise of "Character who knows their in a video game/story". No snarky comments, only barebone anger at "not following the script" & simple "you don't control my destiny" lines. [*] Besides the ink art style, the world building, plot & characters leave a lot to be desired. The dialogue (as in actual script), character motivation and lore are significantly inferior to the art direction. [/list] Enjoyments: [list] [*] The art style is beautiful. The team should be proud of the art direction, because the cut scenes, bosses and overall aesthetics are fantastic. It really did feel like I was playing in an ink painting. [*] Despite my gripes with the combat and hit feedback, I see a lot of potential. I am interested in seeing more pet combinations, and the ink combos (passive & active) are systems I'd love to dive deeper into. The other characters/combat style seemed genuinely interesting too. Just not quite enough to get me excited to jump back in. [*] I think the Chinese mythology & aesthetics was realsied quite well. There aren't enough games that take advantage of this. It could be pushed further. [*] Doge was here. It made me laugh. Nuff said. [/list] I really hope either this game gets patches to improve, or their next game is better. I see potential, and I am invested in seeing it realised in this game or their next. It's not a bad game; a passing grade just isn't good enough in this climate.
